description: Intra-Community supply of goods to an EU customer (zero-rated, E1 box)
notes: Under VATCA s.21, supplies of goods to a person in another EU member state are charged at zero rate. The journal posts the full amount to income with no output VAT. The reverse charge / place of supply rules exist in the KB. Review required because rules carry reviewStatus 'ai_extracted'.
